Three complaints, one sentence, and every one of them turned out to be a single line of code rather than a missing feature. Here is each of them photographed on the pristine build, and again on the fixed one — same island, same seed, same victim, same cameras.

The trail stays

Every number that measures the blood in the water had to hold or rise in the same frame that took the mist out of the air. A fix that reached zero-above-water by making less blood would have been a worse game.
